scope: development-only canonical inventory; not runtime validation, gameplay or exported packaging acceptance

execution.requires: Godot 4.4+ on PATH as godot (substitute godot4 if that is the installed executable)
execution.evidence: Retain stdout/stderr and process exit status, the marked JSON report (UTC time, OS, engine version, command arguments, supplied source revision, absolute dev data root, counts, issues), and git status/diff for uncommitted sources. Capture logs under godot/tests/ or another repository-relative evidence directory; do not commit generated logs as proof of a later revision.

exit_codes.0: Only initial native inventory checks passed; requires a marked passed report and no engine/script errors
exit_codes.1: Inventory or evidence-argument failure; marked failed report lists issues
exit_codes.2: Unsupported Godot version; native acceptance blocked
exit_codes.missing_engine: Native acceptance blocked/unverified; do not substitute Node or browser results for native evidence

execution.parent_data_access: res://../data is read only in this dev acceptance script. It is not an export input or a runtime loading contract.

remaining_gates: Docs Final consistency and explicit owners/decisions
Full schema, references, numeric/formula/quality validation and loader failure matrix

Five-screen native flow; four encounters for all three careers; rewards once, progression, defeat/exit/retry/reset and repeat-run isolation
Native narrow/wide HUD screenshots, touch/keyboard help, numeric/non-color states, 48 dp targets, contrast, device/orientation review
Single canonical export input, JSON inclusion and ID-based loads in an exported build without parent/host dependencies
Independent WS05 art approvals and complete production handoff
Recorded environment, command, revision and evidence for every full gate before milestone advancement
